flags.detail: Only the coupons displayed on the publicly rendered homepage could be verified. The complete printable inventory sits behind the clip/print flow and changes daily, so this dataset does not claim to reproduce it.

Coupons.com mixes three different products on one domain: (1) manufacturer print-at-home coupons, (2) affiliate promo codes, and (3) cashback. Only category (1) is treated as a verified manufacturer coupon in this dataset. Categories (2) and (3) are listed under 'Excluded / unverified' because their codes are published by an affiliate, not by the merchant.
